One day (the event lasts until server save)

On **Kingsday**, Thais is decorated to celebrate {npc:King Tibianus}. During the day the NPCs in Thais speak differently, there are hourly raids in the Knights' Guild arena, and anyone who greets the king gets the achievement **Loyal Subject**. Be careful: anyone who insults the king ends up in Thais prison.
Tibia's capital is completely transformed for the Kingsday festivities.
There is no minimum level for the event; level 8 to take part in the raids.
It only happens when the Kingsday mini world change is active on your server.
Raids in the Knights' Guild arena, where you can loot {item:Party Lampions}, {item:Party Wall Tinsel|Party Wall Tinsels} and {item:Party Wall Snake|Party Wall Snakes}
If it is Sunday: free entry to the {wiki:Tibian Prize Exhibition}

The raid monsters vary a lot: from {creature:Goblin|Goblins} to {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and {creature:Frost Dragon|Frost Dragons}. Do not enter the arena without first checking which raid has spawned.
Never insult the king during Kingsday: there is no way out of prison before the next raid and you cannot log out in there.
1. How to tell it is Kingsday

When Kingsday begins, you will see messages such as *"Hail to the King! It's Kingsday in Thais, join the celebration!"* and *"Hear ye! Hear ye! It is Kingsday, people, let us celebrate and sing! [...] Come to the arena to hear the swords cling. Let us rejoice! Hail to the King!"*

During the day: Thais is decorated (as for {wiki:Tibia's 15th Anniversary|Tibia's 15th Anniversary}); the Thais NPCs speak differently; if it is Sunday, you get into the {wiki:Tibian Prize Exhibition} for free; and there are raids in the Knights' Guild arena every hour.
Kingsday in Thais (player insulting the king)

If you are not in **Thais**, take a boat there (say {key:hi}, {key:thais} and {key:yes} to the captain; you arrive at the harbour, next to {npc:Captain Bluebear}). Go up to Thais castle (1 floor above ground level) and greet {npc:King Tibianus} (for example with {key:hail to the king}). You receive the achievement **Loyal Subject**.
If you insult the king you are sent to the {wiki:Thaian Jail} and stay there until the next raid in the arena. **You cannot log out in prison** and there is no other way out.
Leaving prison (if you insulted the king)

Thais prison is in the **south** of the city, on Harbour Street. There is no way to get out by yourself: wait for the next raid in the arena (every hour). When it starts, you are teleported next to the **stairs out of the prison**; use them to leave the prison and return to the streets of Thais.
Player locked in Thais prison during Kingsday
Going to the Knights' Guild arena

The raids take place in the Knights' Guild arena **every hour**, about 2 to 20 minutes after the hour, in **2 waves**: the second wave appears 2 minutes after the first. Monsters that are not killed disappear 30 minutes after they spawn.
Raid monsters can drop {item:Party Lampions}, {item:Party Wall Tinsel|Party Wall Tinsels} and {item:Party Wall Snake|Party Wall Snakes}.
Each raid is announced with a server message *"The King's mages have summoned some ... in the knight's arena for your enjoyment."*. Possible raids:
{creature:Lizard Sentinel|Lizard Sentinels}, {creature:Lizard Snakecharmer|Lizard Snakecharmers}, {creature:Lizard Templar|Lizard Templars} and {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns}
